iphone-all-commitments.title: All commitments on iPhone
iphone-all-commitments.description: The All commitments screen of longbook on iPhone: every charge ahead, grouped by month, each with its amount, due date, category and account, and Mark paid and Bookmark buttons.

mac-commitments.title: All commitments on Mac
mac-commitments.description: The All commitments screen of longbook on Mac: search, filters for category, account, member, type and status, commitments still to fill in, and every charge ahead grouped by month with Mark paid and Bookmark.

iphone-all-charges.title: All charges on iPhone
iphone-all-charges.description: The All charges screen of longbook on iPhone for August 2026: each charge made that month with its date, category and account.

mac-charges.title: All charges on Mac
mac-charges.description: The All charges screen of longbook on Mac for August 2026: each charge with its date, category and account, and the card bill marked as a transfer.

iphone-members.title: Members on iPhone
iphone-members.description: The Members screen of longbook on iPhone: a card for each person with their commitments, charges, accounts and next commitment.

mac-members.title: Members on Mac
mac-members.description: The Members screen of longbook on Mac: a card for each person, tagged Family, Household help or Landlord, with their commitments, charges, accounts and next commitment.

iphone-accounts.title: Accounts on iPhone
iphone-accounts.description: The Accounts screen of longbook on iPhone: a bank account and a credit card, each with its balance, owner, linked account and next commitment.

mac-accounts.title: Accounts on Mac
mac-accounts.description: The Accounts screen of longbook on Mac: two savings accounts and a credit card side by side, with balances, owners, linked accounts and the next twelve months of commitments.

iphone-categories.title: Categories on iPhone
iphone-categories.description: The category picker of longbook on iPhone: a searchable list of categories such as Streaming, Software, Telecom, Insurance, Rent and Education, with an Add button.

mac-new-commitment.title: New commitment on Mac
mac-new-commitment.description: The New commitment form of longbook on Mac: name, one-time or recurring, the amount in INR, USD, EUR or GBP, the first charge, how far ahead it is planned, a category, an account, a member and notes.

iphone-display-currency.title: Display and currency on iPhone
iphone-display-currency.description: The Display & currency settings of longbook on iPhone: a home currency to choose from INR and USD, or decided from the data, and a choice of dark, light or system appearance.

iphone-dashboard.title: Dashboard on iPhone
iphone-dashboard.description: The longbook dashboard on iPhone: the next commitment, the number of active commitments, the next 30 commitments, and the month's total expenses with a chart by day.

mac-dashboard.title: Dashboard on Mac
mac-dashboard.description: The longbook dashboard on Mac: the next commitment, the next 30 commitments, total expenses by day, spending by account in a ring, and spending by category.

iphone-calendar.title: Calendar on iPhone
iphone-calendar.description: The Calendar of longbook on iPhone for September 2026: each day marked with its number of charges, and a transfer on the 24th.

mac-calendar.title: Calendar on Mac
mac-calendar.description: The Calendar of longbook on Mac for September 2026, with charges marked on their days and a panel for the selected day.

iphone-report.title: Monthly report on iPhone
iphone-report.description: A monthly report of longbook on iPhone for July 2026: the total against June, the number of charges and the money in, and spending by account in a ring.

mac-reports.title: Reports on Mac
mac-reports.description: The Reports screen of longbook on Mac: thirteen monthly reports from September 2025 to September 2026, each drawn by longbook, and a button to upload a bank statement.

iphone-report-sharing.title: Sharing a report on iPhone
iphone-report-sharing.description: Sharing a monthly report from longbook on iPhone: the link, the password and the comments that come back.

mac-report-sharing.title: Sharing a report on Mac
mac-report-sharing.description: Sharing a monthly report from longbook on Mac: the link, the password and the comments that come back.

iphone-import-review.title: Statement import on iPhone
iphone-import-review.description: Importing a bank statement in longbook on iPhone: eight charges and one money in read from an August 2026 statement, with the person and the repeating payments found in it offered as a member and commitments.

mac-import-review.title: Statement import on Mac
mac-import-review.description: Importing a bank statement in longbook on Mac: each line read from the statement with its date, category, amount and the bank's own words, and a box to untick.

iphone-automations.title: Automations on iPhone
iphone-automations.description: The Automations screen of longbook on iPhone: the longbook MCP server switched on, AI suggestions allowed, and the Claude email automation with its prompt.

mac-automations.title: Automations on Mac
mac-automations.description: The Automations screen of longbook on Mac: the longbook MCP server switched on, the Claude email automation, the Shortcuts action for bank messages, and the Siri and Spotlight commands.

iphone-own-ai.title: Connecting Claude on iPhone
iphone-own-ai.description: Importing a statement through Claude in longbook on iPhone: the steps to enable the longbook MCP server, add the connector in Claude and paste the prompt with the statements attached.

mac-mcp-server.title: MCP server on Mac
mac-mcp-server.description: The Automations screen of longbook on Mac with the MCP server on: a hosted copy for AI connectors, AI suggestions, and one-click setup of Claude Desktop on the same Mac.

iphone-changes.title: Changes on iPhone
iphone-changes.description: The Changes screen of longbook on iPhone: charges, a commitment, an account and a member suggested by Claude, with Keep all and Undo all.

mac-changes.title: Changes on Mac
mac-changes.description: The Changes screen of longbook on Mac: charges proposed by Claude with Keep all and Undo all, and the history of earlier versions.

iphone-insights.title: Insights on iPhone
iphone-insights.description: The Insights screen of longbook on iPhone: the notes an AI has left on the dashboard, an account and a member.

mac-insights.title: Insights on Mac
mac-insights.description: The Insights screen of longbook on Mac: the notes an AI has left on the dashboard, an account and a member.

iphone-widget.title: The longbook widget on iPhone
iphone-widget.description: The longbook widget on an iPhone Home Screen, showing the next payment: the day, the total and the names.

mac-menu-bar.title: longbook in the Mac menu bar
mac-menu-bar.description: longbook in the Mac menu bar, showing the next payment and how many days away it is.

iphone-data-privacy.title: Data and privacy on iPhone
iphone-data-privacy.description: The Data & privacy settings of longbook on iPhone: the data file, where the folder lives, Move to iCloud and Make a backup.

mac-data-privacy.title: Data and privacy on Mac
mac-data-privacy.description: The Data & privacy settings of longbook on Mac: the data file, where the folder lives, Move to iCloud, a backup, and what the file cannot hold.
